title: seal
description: Verify Seal AI decision receipts: signed evidence anyone can check, no account needed.
summary: Verify Seal AI decision receipts: signed evidence anyone can check, no account needed.
offersHint: Verify Seal AI decision receipts: signed evidence anyone can check, no account needed. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://app.aqta.ai/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: verify_receipt
toolsPreview.description: Check a receipt signature against a trusted or embedded key. No Aqta service in the check.

toolsPreview.name: decode_receipt
toolsPreview.description: Read a receipt field by field, with stated limits. Does not check the signature.

toolsPreview.name: get_public_key
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the published Seal signing key.

toolsPreview.name: get_sample_receipt
toolsPreview.description: A genuine signed receipt from the sample workspace (demo key), for trying verification.

toolsPreview.name: get_review_pack
toolsPreview.description: The published sample evidence pack: fixed review question, bound receipts, disclosure.

toolsPreview.name: verify_evidence_pack
toolsPreview.description: Verify every receipt in a pack. Per-receipt verdicts, never an average.

toolsPreview.name: explain_attestation_format
toolsPreview.description: The receipt format: fields, outcomes, verification commands, and what a signature does not establish. Use before describing the format.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_receipts
toolsPreview.description: List your workspace receipts filtered by outcome, policy, model, or date range. Requires your aqta_ key as Bearer.

toolsPreview.name: get_transparency_proof
toolsPreview.description: Inclusion proof plus signed tree head for one of your receipts. Requires your aqta_ key.

toolsPreview.name: workspace_summary
toolsPreview.description: Outcome, model and policy counts across your recent receipts. Requires your aqta_ key.
